name: Kerosene
source:
Jewelry store owner.
He was a member of the Red Flower Society, but left the Red Flower Society because he was dissatisfied with the organization after the Francis attack.
Under the influence of Chief Superintendent Lee, he kidnaps Johnny with Lan Yu and Ken, and proposes to Dog Head to become the head of the Red Flower Society, but Dog Head rejects the proposal and the plan fails.
Later, he recognizes Yvet's ability and rejoins the Red Flower society, sending Ken to attack Lao Pao's Fortress Mansion.
